risks.risk: Tyre size/fitment unknown, which can drastically change buyer suitability and price.
risks.proof: A clear sidewall close-up showing the full size marking (e.g., 205/55R16) and brand/model text.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unknown-size used tyre (worst-case for matching), not premium.

risks.risk: Manufacture date (DOT) unknown; '2023 car' may not match tyre production date.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the DOT code (week/year) on the sidewall.

risks.risk: Hidden damage/repairs not confirmable (internal damage, sidewall cuts, prior repair).
risks.proof: Photos of both sidewalls (left/right) and any suspicious spots; ideally a short video rotating the tyre to show bulges.

risks.risk: Tread depth cannot be confirmed as '90%'.
risks.proof: Tread depth gauge reading in mm at 3–4 points and/or photo of wear indicators.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as average used tread (worst-case vs 90% claim).

Send photos of both sidewalls (full circumference) to confirm no cuts/repairs/bulges.
Send tread depth measurements (mm) at multiple points or a photo showing wear indicators.
Confirm quantity and whether all tyres are the same size/model.
